description:
"Tale of Gyeryong Fairy" also called "Mama Fairy And The Woodcutter" is a webtoon telling the story of a woman fairy that lived in Goryeo and Joseon, she is now a 'barista'. She is waiting for her husband to reincarnate to be able to get her winged clothing back.

Original Webtoon: [Naver Comic](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=693431), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=2678871)

Official Translations:
